title: fuertesimalva corniculata
intro: Fuertesimalva corniculata, commonly known as "yerba de los burros," is a medicinal plant native to South America. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and inflammation. The health benefits of Fuertesimalva corniculata are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
